notes: Over-watering guard: after WATER_REST_AFTER_DAYS consecutive days that received water OR significant actual rainfall (>= rain-skip amount), skip WATER_REST_DURATION_DAYS days (defaults 3 -> 1, Gist-configurable via watering.rest_after_consecutive_days / rest_duration_days; 0 disables). Streak finalised once/day at the new-day rollover using state.bin bytes 2-3; new skip_reason 'rest_day'; counters logged + shown in 'status'.
